correctness.rationale: Exact wrapped-pulse integration gives I=C(A exp(b phi)+B exp(-a phi)), with strictly positive second derivative, opposite endpoint derivative signs and equal maxima. This proves the exact minimizer and all invasion-multiplier phase cases. The uniform sawtooth correlation expansion gives universal PQ/8, and direct logarithmic asymptotics prove large-T behavior. A standalone exact rational interval certificate and 3166 supplementary computational checks passed.

The published two-patch culling result has a different noncommutative mechanism. A full-text access gap and possible unindexed signal-processing literature leave priority risk; no stronger inspected implication covers the complete new claim.

Published circular cross-correlation or control-theoretic tables not encountered in the bounded search could contain a mathematically equivalent closed form or optimization.
The synergy term is a stated modeling assumption, not biologically calibrated, and the exact result does not transfer automatically to nonlinear systems.

value.rationale: At fixed pulse totals and fixed per-agent integrated exposures, varying only relative phase can change the sign of an infestation invasion exponent when positive concentration-product suppression operates. The exact unique worst stagger shifts away from half-period with unequal clearance; the universal short-period gap and harmonic-rate large-period decay provide natural benchmarks for timed multi-agent interactions. The result is neither a restatement of additive Floquet stability nor an unmotivated numerical slice. It makes no field-efficacy claim.
